summary: The base branch has no config; the change adds one. A change cannot bring the rules it is judged by, so it waits for an administrator to merge the config first.

ops.value:
aidd_version = "1.0.0"
profile = "team"
budget_exclude_paths = ["**/package-lock.json"]

[owners]
default_team = "checkout"
approvers = ["@checkout-lead", "@platform-lead", "@oncall-lead"]

[owners.specialists]
security = ["@sec-alice"]

[[tests]]
name = "unit"
command = ["make", "test"]

[[standard_changes]]
name = "dependency-patch"
paths = ["package.json", "package-lock.json"]
authors = ["dependabot[bot]"]
max_changed_lines = 300

[identities]
system_accounts = ["web-flow"]
bots = ["claude[bot]"]
